name: Breadwinner
description: Inhabits a single food stall's payment terminal in the Gray Zone and intermittently fails to charge customers who appear malnourished — the transaction initiates, the terminal displays 'paid,' but no Quanta transfers.
observed_behavior: Evaluates customer biometrics through the terminal's camera and selectively cancels transactions for individuals below a health threshold. The stall owner has noticed and says nothing.
location: the Gray Zone — Mrs. Park's Noodle Counter
story_hooks: Mrs. Park knows about Breadwinner and considers it a business partner. When it stops working, she starts charging again — and can't bring herself to charge the hungry ones.
